relevance_note: Patient 29 has Majeed syndrome with two LPIN2 variants: 'A diagnosis of Majeed syndrome was confirmed for patient 29 with a very typical phenotype (Table 3) and compound heterozygous mutations in LPIN2 (p.P626S and p.S203F).'; four further patients carry LPIN2 variants.
method_note: Cohort/panel-validation paper (72 patients: 22 positive controls, 50 undiagnosed). In scope: every patient with an LPIN2 variant (patients 29 and 30 in Table 3; patients 43, 67 and 70 in the S6 Table excerpt); no relatives are described. Only patient 29 has a diagnosis of Majeed syndrome; 30 (ALPS type 2A), 43 (unclassified AID), 67 (ANCA vasculitis) and 70 (alveolar hypoplasia/pulmonary hypertension) carry LPIN2 variants with other diagnoses. Labels: the text names patients 29, 30 and 43 ('patients 43' in a list), so rule 1; patients 67 and 70 appear only in the S6 Table 'Patient no.' column, so 'Table S6 #<n>'. A short Python script transcribed the Table 3 and S6 rows of these five patients (gene, nucleotide, amino acid, zygosity, class) and built row-prefix spans; I checked each row against the table. All variants the tables attribute to these patients (including other genes) were recorded; nucleotide changes are printed without 'c.' and kept as printed (e.g. FAS 'A136A>C', WAS 'T337T>C'). Pathogenicity is the table's class column with the Methods class definitions as second span; the '(S)' level-of-evidence letter is not an ACMG criterion code, so ACMG is not reported. Patient 29 LPIN2 zygosity recorded as compound heterozygous from the text sentence naming patient 29, although each Table 3 row reads 'Het' (phase testing not described). LPIN2 transcript NM_014646 given for Table 3 rows from the Table 3 footnote (annotated per the RefSeq transcript in S1/S2 Tables) plus the S1/S2 gene-list row; the S6 footnote is not in the excerpt, so S6 rows have transcript not reported. The S6 Table is an excerpt with [...]: patient 67's rows may continue after NCF1 and patient 70's rows may begin before COL5A1, so their lists of other-gene variants may be incomplete. S6 abbreviations (F, Y/N/U, Age**) are not defined in the S6 excerpt; I used the identical Table 3 legend definitions as second spans. Consanguinity 'U' (unknown) and ethnicity 'U' for patient 67 recorded as not reported. Patient 67's 'suspected microscopic polyangiitis' was not recorded as a feature (hedged diagnosis); 'MPO ANCA -positive' was. Arthritis (patient 30) was not mapped to the checklist joint items. No contradictions found in the paper for these patients.
